message: Journal writing can also be importnt for the present-day self, as a way to figure out something.  Isn't this what free-writing is about, a way to get past first thoughts (as Natalie Goldberg) would say and to get to deeper thoughts that we have?  In other words, it's still not writing for wrting's sake but writing to help the writer in a present situation, perhaps, so it's writing that has an effect outside the writing.
